title: Artist identity inside the listening interface
slide_intent: Connect expressive artist imagery to a usable listening surface so discovery feels personal and the next action stays clear.
strategic_value: Spotify can carry campaign energy into its product through the bright Bad Bunny portrait while the dark track list remains readable.
demonstration: A hand holds a tilted phone against a blue-to-green field. A red and purple artist header sits above a dark track list and green play control.
practical_value: Judge how much expressive color a product header can carry before it competes with navigation.

content_islands.name: Artist header
content_islands.spec: The upper phone screen combines a close portrait, vivid red field and green Bad Bunny title.

content_islands.name: Listening controls
content_islands.spec: The lower screen uses dark rows and a green play button to turn recognition into listening.

content_islands.name: Physical context
content_islands.spec: A hand and diagonal device frame show the identity at handheld scale against a color field.
